title: Ungraded enrollments
statementMd:
How many enrollments have no score yet?

Expected columns: `ungraded`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ungraded FROM enrollments WHERE score IS NULL;
```
